visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a short brown bob hairstyle, wearing a light pink hooded sweatshirt, sits at a wooden table in an indoor living room. She faces a white hexagonal pizza box tied with a complex red and yellow ribbon knot. The background features a couch and a shelf with a lightbox reading 'KIKI EAT'. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up of her hands as she focuses on the ribbon knot. She takes one loose end of the red ribbon and twists it tightly between her fingers until it becomes a rigid, stiffened cylinder. (3) She then pushes the stiffened end of the ribbon through the center of the knot, creating slack. (4) Pulling the ribbon through the other side, the entire knot easily unravels. She looks back at the camera with a wide smile and joyful expression, performing a small victory gesture with her hand while looking satisfied with the result.
